title: Accepting the music business and rotating favorites
summary: Machito says he waited his time, calls it business, and notes that records fall from the charts as the industry rotates favorites.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship

blocks.x: Okay, it didn't annoy you. It didn't bother you?
Well, naturally, but what can you do? I was waiting my time. My time will come and, you know, the man up there, God, allow you to do a lot of things .....
I heard a lot of musicians say: "Well, it's business". Do you look at it the same way?
It is business and it doesn't bother you.
Okay. Has it ever been that way, that you were the favorite and other people were kept out?

Yes. Life is a rotation. You find out that you are the top twenty and they play your record, when you fall from the top forty they don't play your record as much as the top twenty or the top ten because that's the way the industry runs.
